Updated October 19, 2026. **Customization is usable; complete character quality is still in progress.** Checked items describe the supported features or artist deliverables below, within their recorded review limits.

## Usable now

- [x] Switch between two accepted bob haircuts while retaining applied outfit settings. [Hair chooser evidence](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-03/hair-cut/README.md)
- [x] Customize hair base/tint and individual Top/Bottom/Shoes colours on supported looks. [Current feature status](PRODUCT-ROADMAP.md)
- [x] Save, reopen, rename and remove supported named looks; inspect their configured colour chips. [Saved-look evidence](evidence/appearance-2026-10-02/saved-colours/README.md), [feature status](PRODUCT-ROADMAP.md), [numeric-data and removal-Undo safety](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-06/saved-collection-number-adoption/README.md)
- [x] Download a saved look's JSON without replacing the active preview. [Export evidence](evidence/appearance-2026-10-02/saved-export/README.md)
- [x] Use the mobile view-controls row with visible boots in reviewed layouts; short screens require scrolling. [Layout evidence](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-03/mobile-toolbar/RECEIPT.md)
- [x] Open the optional Ink and denim outfit and compare its captured room/portrait views. [Open and compare Ink](../looks/INK-DENIM.md)
- [x] Request, read and dismiss explained outfit suggestions in the optional Showcase panel, and view readonly settings on desktop; the exported configuration stayed identical through Request/Dismiss. The mobile suggestion card is readable in the reviewed layout. [Current controls and review limits](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-05/showcase-viewport-ui/README.md), [earlier pinned desktop study](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-04/catalogue-proposal-ui/README.md)

- [x] Editable five-piece sweater sheet with named joins and openings. [SVG and JSON](evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/piece-publisher/README.md)

- [x] Editable unitless trouser blockout with an authored seat, shared crotch and three actual mesh views. [Source and OBJ](evidence/appearance-2026-10-04/trouser-artist-source/README.md)

- [x] Editable unitless open overshirt blockout with an attached collar, full hanging sleeves and an actual front/profile/rear image; collar/cuff finish and wearable fit remain open. [Source, OBJ and reviewed image](evidence/appearance-2026-10-05/overshirt-first-view/README.md)

- [x] Editable unitless paired ankle-boot blockout with inner surfaces and a fictional reference volume, crossing laces, rear counters and an actual front/profile/rear image; body fit and finished footwear remain open. [Source, OBJ and reviewed image](evidence/appearance-2026-10-05/boot-artist-first-view/README.md)

- [x] Original short-groom, layered masculine artist target, with full-body and portrait discussion views. [Character design](research/MASCULINE-CHARACTER-TARGET-2026-10-04.md)

- [x] Original Mara artist discussion sheet with full-body and portrait views, silver bob and an open cardigan/plum midi direction; editable character, fit, motion and runtime remain open. [Character design](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-05/mature-wardrobe-board/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Mara long-cardigan technical drawing with front, profile, rear and smaller inside-facing views; unitless artist design, with sewing, 3D, body fit and motion still open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-05/mara-cardigan-first-native/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Mara loafer technical drawing with top, profile, front, rear, outsole and inside views of one left shoe; unitless artist intent, with anatomical pairing, manufacturing, 3D fit and motion still open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-06/mara-loafer-first-native/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original Ari broader-frame artist discussion sheet with front, profile, rear and portrait views, short rust jacket and generous ink trousers; material, waist details, editable character, fit and motion remain open. [Character design and review limits](evidence/appearance-2026-10-07/larger-frame-character/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Ari bomber technical drawing with front, right profile, rear, inside front-panel schematic and zipper/hem details; sewing, physical dimensions, full interior, 3D fit and motion remain open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-07/ari-bomber-drawing/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Ari lining and facing artist sheet with front, back, both sleeve linings and pocket-layer details; physical interior, sewing, 3D fit and motion remain open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-18/ari-interior-artist/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Ari trouser artist sheet with front, profile, rear and waist/pleat/fly/pocket-layer/hem intent; sewing, physical fit, 3D and motion remain open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-18/ari-trouser-artist/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Ari ivory low-top artist sheet with six left-shoe views and enlarged entry/lacing intent; unitless 2D design, with physical continuity, manufacturing, anatomical pairing, 3D fit and motion still open. - [ ] Convincing hair, skin and complete characters from useful angles and during motion.
- [ ] A finished relaxed sweater and wider trousers matching the retained character target.
- [ ] Attractive complete outfits, layering and independently wearable mix-and-match pieces.
- [ ] Body/foundation/garment fit and coverage across intended bodies, morphs and moving poses.
- [ ] Curated masculine, feminine and deliberate gender-neutral starter characters, each reviewed as a complete look.
- [ ] Expressions, gaze and gestures that convey the intended human meaning, including determination, coyness and teasing. Existing attention and optional smile controls are bounded starting points.
- [ ] Agent outfit suggestions using combinations that exist and fit.
- [ ] Representative performance qualification against explicit device, resolution, frame-time and memory budgets.
- [ ] VTuber-style characters with deliberate proportions, materials, motion and customization.
- [ ] Mii-like characters with clear expression, representation and style-specific quality checks.

The [full roadmap](PRODUCT-ROADMAP.md) retains these goals and their acceptance limits. The next substantial slice should produce an artist-owned character or wardrobe improvement with an actual visual comparison and independent critique.

# Sugata project checklist

Updated October 19, 2026. **Customization is usable; complete character quality is still in progress.** Checked items describe the supported features or artist deliverables below, within their recorded review limits.

## Usable now

- [x] Switch between two accepted bob haircuts while retaining applied outfit settings. [Hair chooser evidence](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-03/hair-cut/README.md)
- [x] Customize hair base/tint and individual Top/Bottom/Shoes colours on supported looks. [Current feature status](PRODUCT-ROADMAP.md)
- [x] Save, reopen, rename and remove supported named looks; inspect their configured colour chips. [Saved-look evidence](evidence/appearance-2026-10-02/saved-colours/README.md), [feature status](PRODUCT-ROADMAP.md), [numeric-data and removal-Undo safety](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-06/saved-collection-number-adoption/README.md)

- [x] Open the optional Ink and denim outfit and compare its captured room/portrait views. [Open and compare Ink](../looks/INK-DENIM.md)
- [x] Request, read and dismiss explained outfit suggestions in the optional Showcase panel, and view readonly settings on desktop; the exported configuration stayed identical through Request/Dismiss. The mobile suggestion card is readable in the reviewed layout. [Current controls and review limits](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-05/showcase-viewport-ui/README.md), [earlier pinned desktop study](evidence/nonhair-2026-10-04/catalogue-proposal-ui/README.md)

## Artist and research deliverables available

- [x] Editable unitless paired ankle-boot blockout with inner surfaces and a fictional reference volume, crossing laces, rear counters and an actual front/profile/rear image; body fit and finished footwear remain open. [Source, OBJ and reviewed image](evidence/appearance-2026-10-05/boot-artist-first-view/README.md)

- [x] Original editable Mara loafer technical drawing with top, profile, front, rear, outsole and inside views of one left shoe; unitless artist intent, with anatomical pairing, manufacturing, 3D fit and motion still open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-06/mara-loafer-first-native/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original Ari broader-frame artist discussion sheet with front, profile, rear and portrait views, short rust jacket and generous ink trousers; material, waist details, editable character, fit and motion remain open. [Character design and review limits](evidence/appearance-2026-10-07/larger-frame-character/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Ari bomber technical drawing with front, right profile, rear, inside front-panel schematic and zipper/hem details; sewing, physical dimensions, full interior, 3D fit and motion remain open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-07/ari-bomber-drawing/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Ari lining and facing artist sheet with front, back, both sleeve linings and pocket-layer details; physical interior, sewing, 3D fit and motion remain open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-18/ari-interior-artist/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Ari trouser artist sheet with front, profile, rear and waist/pleat/fly/pocket-layer/hem intent; sewing, physical fit, 3D and motion remain open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-18/ari-trouser-artist/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

- [x] Original editable Ari ivory low-top artist sheet with six left-shoe views and enlarged entry/lacing intent; unitless 2D design, with physical continuity, manufacturing, anatomical pairing, 3D fit and motion still open. [SVG, JSON and reviewed sheet](evidence/appearance-2026-10-19/ari-sneaker-artist/ARTIST-HANDOFF.md)

[Open the visual wardrobe board](ARTIST-WARDROBE.html) to inspect selected retained character directions and editable drafts. The supplementary sheets linked above are available separately.

These references do not establish physical folding, wearable fit or finished garment appearance. The original body/foundation source data and coverage guide support further authorship. The latest sewn-panel trial failed its clearance requirement and remains isolated. [Current evidence and recovery](DAY-REPORT-2026-10-04.md)

## Outstanding

- [ ] Convincing hair, skin and complete characters from useful angles and during motion.
- [ ] A finished relaxed sweater and wider trousers matching the retained character target.
- [ ] Attractive complete outfits, layering and independently wearable mix-and-match pieces.
- [ ] Body/foundation/garment fit and coverage across intended bodies, morphs and moving poses.
- [ ] Curated masculine, feminine and deliberate gender-neutral starter characters, each reviewed as a complete look.
- [ ] Expressions, gaze and gestures that convey the intended human meaning, including determination, coyness and teasing. Existing attention and optional smile controls are bounded starting points.
- [ ] Agent outfit suggestions using combinations that exist and fit.
- [ ] Representative performance qualification against explicit device, resolution, frame-time and memory budgets.
- [ ] VTuber-style characters with deliberate proportions, materials, motion and customization.
- [ ] Mii-like characters with clear expression, representation and style-specific quality checks.

The [full roadmap](PRODUCT-ROADMAP.md) retains these goals and their acceptance limits. The next substantial slice should produce an artist-owned character or wardrobe improvement with an actual visual comparison and independent critique.
